endInclusive.description: make the end date inclusive instead of exclusive

forceReEval.description: force redundant evaluations with same input data (ignore eval history)

startOfTime.description: set start-of-time point (if not beginning of data)

analyticWhitelist.description: analytics allowed to be invoked; if null/empty, all are allowed

metricFailure.description:
handling of metric/event evaluation errors
- immediate: abort on individual metric failures
- atEnd: collect all metric failures and fail at very end
- ignore: treat metric failures as empty (0% complete)

batchSize.description: size of invalidation batches in map/reduce jobs

ignoreMissingSource.description: When true, the action will not throw missing source exception.

objTypeRef.description: For {@link App#rebuild} operations, used to pass the type associated with a request in a particular batch.

ids.description:
Specific list of ids to process/refresh.  If specified, then {@link startFromId} and {@link endId} are ignored.
If not specified (or empty) then all will be refreshed, applying any specified {@link startFromId} and
{@link endId}.

startFromId.description: Starting id for a range of ids to process.  Ignored if {@link ids} is also specified and not empty.

endId.description: Ending id for a range of ids to process.  Ignored if {@link startFromId} is not specified and not empty.

filter.description:
Filter to identify which objs to process.  Can be specified in addition to {@link ids} or
{@link startFromId}/{@link endId}.  In that case only objs that satisfy both the filter and the id base filter
will be promised.

subBatchSize.description:
Number of objs to operate on in synchronous call.  When specified in async call, the value is passed in to
subsequent synchronous call. Defaults to {@link batchSize}.

invalidationsBatchSize.description: Number of entries to submit to the invalidation queue at one time for async call.

sync.description: True if the request should be processed synchronously.

priority.description: Initial priority of batch jobs started from async processing.

batchJob.description: If the request is part of a larger batch job (e.g. {@link App#rebuild}), this will be set by the framework to the owning batch job for orchestration.

batchNum.description: Numerical batch number set by the framework in {@link BatchJob.scheduleObjBatch}

disabled.description:
Indicates that the job is in the disabled state meaning that no queue entries will be processed for the job.
This should only be set manually when initially creating/starting the job.  To disable/enable a running job call
{@link disable}/{@link enable}.

maxConcurrency.description:
The maximum number of invalidation queue entries that will be processed simultaneously for a job.  If -1, no limit
is applied. This is enforced independently of {@link maxConcurrencyPerNode}.

maxConcurrencyPerNode.description:
The maximum number of invalidation queue entries that will be processed simultaneously for a job per node.  If -1,
no limit is applied.  This is enforced independently of {@link maxConcurrency}.

runAsUser.description:
If true, the appropriate functions (e.g. map/reduce in MapReduce and processBatch in BatchJob) will be run as the
user who started the job.  If false, they will be run as root.

nodePool.description:
When non-null, invalidation queue entries for the job will only be processed by servers with a matching
nodePool.  When null, invalidation queue entries for the job will only be processed by servers from default
nodePool.

skipIfRunning.description:
If true, attempts to start the job will be ignored if it is already running and no error will be thrown.  This is useful,
for instance, if a cron job starts a job and the job from a previous cron invocation may not have completed before the next
scheduled run.

If false, an error will be thrown if an attempt is made to start the job if it is already running.

numAutoRecoveryAttempts.description: Set to between 1 and 5 to enable auto recovery. See {@link invalidation-queues.c3doc Invalidation Queues} for detailed documentation.

start.description: Start of time range to refresh analytics for.  If null, BOT is assumed.

end.description: End of time range to refresh analytics for.  If null, EOT is assumed.
